title: 4600 Donegal Bay Court, Killeen, TX 76549
description:
Spacious Two Story with Open Living, Loft Flex Space and Covered Patio Retreat!

This home makes a strong first impression the moment you arrive, with its classic brick exterior, inviting front porch, and mature tree adding both shade and character. Step inside to a bright, open layout where natural light fills the space and the soaring ceilings create an immediate sense of openness. The living area flows effortlessly into the dining space and kitchen, giving you a layout that feels connected without losing definition.

The kitchen is designed for everyday function with clean white cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and plenty of counter space to prep, cook, and gather. Just off the kitchen, the dining area sits perfectly positioned for both casual meals and hosting, with easy access to the backyard for indoor-outdoor living. The mix of durable flooring downstairs and soft carpet in the living areas keeps the home comfortable while staying practical.

Upstairs, the layout opens to a spacious loft area overlooking the main level, offering flexibility for a second living space, home office, or game room. The bedrooms are well-sized with great natural light, and the primary suite gives you the space you want along with a large bathroom setup featuring dual sinks and plenty of storage. The additional bedrooms and bathrooms are positioned to keep daily routines flowing smoothly.

Out back, you will find a fully fenced yard with plenty of room to spread out, whether that means relaxing under the covered patio or creating your own outdoor setup. There is space here to make it your own without feeling overwhelming to maintain.

See it in person and decide how it compares to what else is available.
